poses.title: Expired. Still here.
poses.caption: Before Opening state: expired freshness tab and intact, notched local image.

poses.title: Only freshness expired.
poses.caption: Action Attention shifts to the independent freshness tab; the image stays untouched.

poses.title: The image stays.
poses.caption: Result The opening contradiction remains visible, awaiting the explanation.

poses.title: A stored response.
poses.caption: Before The lightbox identifies browser-local storage.

poses.title: Freshness is separate.
poses.caption: Action The marker and body are physically separate pieces, not a deletion timer.

poses.title: Still stored.
poses.caption: Result The notched v7 image remains in the same lightbox.

poses.title: Fresh reuse.
poses.caption: Before Policy permits fresh reuse; server is present and idle.

poses.title: Use the local copy.
poses.caption: Action A view of the stored body supplies the local display; no outbound request.

poses.title: No new image transfer.
poses.caption: Result Identical notch and hill image connect stored body with local display.

poses.title: Freshness can end.
poses.caption: Before Freshness and image remain separate before the state change.

poses.title: Now stale.
poses.caption: Action Only the marker changes; the same image body remains fully opaque.

poses.title: Stale. Still stored.
poses.caption: Result No eviction, fading, damaged pixels or automatic re-download implied.

texts.text: The browser may need a check.

poses.title: A version label.
poses.caption: Before Saved ETag v7 is attached to the retained image response.

poses.title: Send the saved label.
poses.caption: Action Explicit midpoint: only the validator slip leaves; the body remains local.

poses.title: The request arrives.
poses.caption: Result Server-side request arrival, with the original local image still readable.

poses.title: Which version?
poses.caption: Before Same request remains at the server after line 5; the actual saved image stays local.

poses.title: Compare at the server.
poses.caption: Action The request reaches the labeled server area before comparison.

poses.title: The image stays local.
poses.caption: Result The conditional request did not upload the cached body.

poses.title: The version matches.
poses.caption: Before Saved and current ETags match at the server for this representation.

poses.title: 304 Not Modified.
poses.caption: Action The server issues status/metadata only; this reply contains no image body.

poses.title: Reuse the saved body.
poses.caption: Result Local display uses existing v7 body after 304, not a body arriving from server.

poses.title: Changed instead.
poses.caption: Before Separate alternative: server v8 differs; alternate cache still holds v7. Main v7 remains below.

poses.title: 200 brings the image.
poses.caption: Action New body v8 is in transit, outside storage. Alternate old body stays visible until arrival.

poses.title: Replace after arrival.
poses.caption: Result Only alternate cache becomes v8. Main retained v7 witness remains unchanged.

poses.title: Example conditions.
poses.caption: Before Return emphasis to the unchanged-path witness; no reversal of alternate v8.

poses.title: Reuse when allowed.
poses.caption: Action Policy is a stated condition, not a universal browser behavior.

poses.title: A copy must remain.
poses.caption: Result The shown v7 body was retained, not evicted; no new eviction plot.

poses.title: Expired. Still useful.
poses.caption: Before The main unchanged path is explicitly restored to focus; alternate v8 was not undone.

poses.title: Check permits reuse.
poses.caption: Action The matching check connects 304 to a local view of the original v7 body.

poses.title: The image it has.
poses.caption: Result Bookend: same notched image and expired freshness marker, now with the reuse condition earned.
